Israeli Strikes Kill 11 in Gaza, Including Children

Israeli airstrikes in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of 11 people, according to Gaza health officials. Among the casualties were children, with one report specifying a family of five, including three children, was killed. The strikes occurred amidst ongoing conflict and discussions about Israeli strategy in the region.
